instruction.name: xvssrlrn.hu.w
instruction.description: Logical right shift with rounding each unsigned 32-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 32, saturate the result to unsigned 16-bit, write it into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvssrlrn.hu.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
